title: Split a list
summary: Erlang: Split a list. Change the first number.
introduction: [Head | Tail] separates the first item from the rest of a list.

blocks.text: Save each example as lesson.erl. Run erlc lesson.erl, then erl -noshell -s lesson main -s init stop. The file name must match the module name.
The head-tail pattern puts 4 in First. The remaining list is ignored.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: An empty list cannot match a head-and-tail pattern.
